programme.title: Harlequin: This Matter of Marriage
programme.desc: Arkitekterna Hallie och Donnalee driver ett stort byggprojekt för en excentrisk miljardär, Adam Barr. Hallie, som har letat efter sin drömman, hittar honom plötsligt i grannhuset. Denna film visas utan svenska undertexter.

programme.title: Harlequin: Hard to Forget
programme.desc: Privatdetektiven Max Warner är övertygad om att Sandra Applewhites död inte var en olyckshändelse utan att hennes make John Gilman mördade henne. När han möter Sandras tvillingsyster Nicky ber han henne om hjälp. Denna film visas utan svenska undertexter

programme.title: Harlequin: Diamond Girl
programme.desc: Playboy-advokaten Denny Montana ger aldrig sin sjaskiga biträdande jurist Claire Bernard en andra blick. Men när han börjar se en oslipad diamant i Claire, börjar han förvandla henne till en förtjusande skönhet. Denna film visas utan svenska undertexter.

programme.title: Harlequin: The Waiting Game
programme.desc: Sarah och Amy, bästa vänner sedan universitetet, anordnar sin första konstutställning i en liten stad i New England. När gåtfulla främlingar kommer in i deras liv och romantik uppstår utvecklas det utmaningar. Denna film visas utan svenska undertexter

programme.title: Harlequin: Loving Evangeline
programme.desc: När Robert får veta om sin brors båtolycka ger han sig ut för att hämta kroppen och möter Evie Shaw, ägare till marinan där hans bror hyrde båten. Han blir besatt av sin brors misstänkta död ... och av Evie. Denna film visas utan svenska undertexter.

programme.title: Harlequin: Recipe for Revenge
programme.desc: Cateringfirman Carly Westin går med på att förbereda en festmåltid för en vän som vill imponera på en man. Men paret blir dödat när hon är i köket. När polisutredaren Jack blir inblandad måste han skydda Carly. Denna film visas utan svenska undertexter.

programme.title: Harlequin: A Change of Place
programme.desc: När den oroliga Dominique ber sin bokälskande syster Kimberly att anta rollen som en glamorös parisisk modell i en månad, tvekar Kimberly. Denna film visas utan svenska undertexter.

programme.title: Harlequin: Another Woman
programme.desc: När Lisa vaknar upp på sjukhuset minns hon ingenting: vem hon är, hennes man Pauls avsikt att skilja sig från henne eller att hon blev svårt misshandlad och lämnad att dö i en gränd. Denna film visas utan svenska undertexter.

programme.title: Harlequin: Treacherous Beauties
programme.desc: Anne Marie Kerr misstänker att hennes bror Alans död inte är en olycka och bestämmer sig för att utreda saken. Hon börjar arbeta för den mäktiga familjen som kan vara inblandad i Alans död. Denna film visas utan svenska undertexter.

programme.title: Harlequin: Broken Lullaby
programme.desc: En föräldralös (Mel Harris) strävan att spåra sitt förflutna börjar med ett barndomsfoto av henne själv bredvid en sällsynt speldosa och leder henne till en förförisk skattjägare. Denna film visas utan svenska undertexter.

programme.title: Ridiculousness

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: I det här avsnittet av Ridiculousness dyker Rob Dyrdek, Steelo Brim och Lolo Wood rakt ner spenaten i 'Käka gräs', blir vältränade tillsammans med muskliga hundar i 'Gymhundar' och går under nollstrecket för 'Djupfryst glädje'.

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: I det här avsnittet av Ridiculousness skapar Rob, Steelo och Lolo Wood sina egna halkfaror i 'Självsladdare', tittar förbi på gymmet för att bli 'Boxad av säck' och utmanar höjdskräcken ordentligt i 'Galna höjder'.

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: I dethär avsnittet av Ridiculousness tar sig Rob, Steelo och Lolo Wood lätt över 'Skyddsstängsel', behöver en detalj i 'Bil-varelser' och testar sin halsningsförmåga i 'Halsning kommer upp igen'.

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: I detta Ridiculousness träffar Rob, Steelo, Lolo Wood och Dee Snider rebeller i 'Tänker inte tåla det', bevittnar band som stretar på i 'Kommer inte slå igenom' och upplever sorgen i att spilla ut kaffet i 'Kaffetragedier'.

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: I kvällens avsnitt av Ridiculousness tar Rob, Steelo och Lolo Wood en titt på konsekvenserna av att inte se skyltar i 'Skyltblind', lär sig udda fakta i 'Tekniskt sett sant' och får erfara hur galet det kan gå i 'Galnare och galnare'.

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: I kvällens avsnitt av Ridiculousness ser Rob, Steelo, and Lolo Wood cyklister bli otrevligt överraskade i 'Oväntade cykelhinder', träffar på elaka katter i 'Kattvrede' innan de slutligen ser folk fastna i 'Skallfällor'.

programme.title: Ridiculousness

programme.desc: Steven återvänder till herrgården för att återhämta sig från de skador han fick vid fallet. Krystles brorsdotter Sammy Jo anländer för att tillbringa några veckor hos familjen Carrigton.

programme.desc: Den första nakna nybörjaren spiller ingen tid. Vissa relationer går framåt medan andra går bakåt, och det blir spänt innan en dejtare dumpas för gott.

programme.title: The Millers: Stuff
programme.desc: Nathan hatches a plan to get his parents back together by showing them all of their sentimental family possessions in the hopes it will make them remember the good times they've had.

programme.title: The Millers: The Phone Upgrade
programme.desc: Nathan and Debbie trade parents when they each think the other sibling has it easier.

programme.title: The Millers: Plot Twists
programme.desc: When Carol dictates that it's time to rearrange the family's positions in the Millers cemetery plot because of the two divorces.

programme.title: The Millers: The Mother Is In
programme.desc: When Carol finds out that Nathan is seeing a therapist, she secretly makes an appointment for herself in order to find out what's going on.

programme.title: The Millers: Giving The Bird
programme.desc: It's Halloween, and Nathan, Debbie, and Adam take Mikayla trick-or-treating to the house of an old woman who everyone in the neighborhood thinks is a witch.

programme.title: The Millers: Driving Miss Crazy
programme.desc: When Nathan gets frustrated after he's forced to drive Carol around town for errands once again, he demands that she either learn how to drive or find another chauffeur.

programme.title: The Millers: Internet Dating
programme.desc: When Nathan helps Carol set up her profile on an Internet dating site, he and Ray get so excited about one of her potential suitors, they start corresponding with him, pretending to be Carol.

programme.title: The Millers: You're In Trouble
programme.desc: When Nathan learns why Debbie is Tom's favorite child instead of him, he decides it's time to fill his parents in on some of Debbie's childhood secrets.

programme.title: The Millers: The Talk
programme.desc: When Carol finds out that Tom never had "the talk" with Nathan about the birds and the bees, she insists it's not too late to gather the family together and do it now.

programme.title: The Millers: Carol's Parents Are Coming to Town
programme.desc: When Carol's overbearing mother and father announce they're coming to visit for Christmas, Carol recruits Nate and Tom to cover up their failed relationships and present a happy facade.
programme.sub-title: Carol's Parents Are Coming to Town

programme.title: The Millers: Dear Diary
programme.desc: When Debbie suspects Nathan and Carol of secretly reading her diary, she and Adam plant a fake entry about Tom in order to prove it. Ernie Hudson guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Miller's Mind
programme.desc: Nathan learns to appreciate Carol's incessant rants after he mimics one of them at work and is rewarded with his own news segment to complain on the air.

programme.title: The Millers: Carol's Surprise
programme.desc: Nathan is determined to finally, just once, surprise the "unsurpriseable" Carol on her birthday. Brandon Routh guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: You Betcha
programme.desc: Nathan asks Tom to spend the weekend with him in the hopes of finding something they have in common.

programme.title: The Millers: Bahama Mama
programme.desc: Just as Nathan begins to unwind on his vacation in the Bahamas, Carol's surprise appearance gets him riled up all over again until they meet Ganja Pete.

programme.title: The Millers: Tomlandia
programme.desc: When Nathan pitches a children's show to his boss, Ed Dolan, based on Tom's imaginary comic book, Tom has an adverse reaction to the tweaks made to his cherished world. Jeffrey Tambor guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Plus One
programme.desc: Nathan's excitement at scoring a ticket for himself and a guest to a dinner with President Obama turns to dread when he has to pick one of his family members to be his "plus one."

programme.title: The Millers: Walk-n-Wave
programme.desc: Worried that his mother has made him feel like he's better than other people, Nathan befriends a hopeless co-worker, Doug, who turns out to be a social outcast and more than Nathan knows how to handle.

programme.title: The Millers: Cancellation Fee
programme.desc: Nathan tries to date his mother's dentist in secret after Carol adds her to the Miller Family Blacklist for charging her a $75 cancellation fee for being late to her appointment.

programme.title: The Millers: 72
programme.desc: When Tom proudly tells the family he's dating a much younger woman, Nathan goes undercover to spy on him and make sure his father isn't being scammed by a gold digger.

programme.title: The Millers: Sex Ed Dolan
programme.desc: Nathan introduces his boss, Ed Dolan, to Tom in hopes they'll hit it off and hang out together, but surprisingly, Dolan only has eyes for Carol. Jeffrey Tambor guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Mother's Day
programme.desc: Carol has the worst Mother's Day ever when Nathan forgets to get her a present.

programme.title: The Millers: Movin' Out (Carol's Song)
programme.desc: Carol begins her search for a new apartment, causing Nathan and Debbie to race each other to find her a place that is the farthest away from each of them.

programme.title: The Millers: CON-Troversy
programme.desc: Nathan is assigned to cover a Sci-Fi Fest for his workplace and runs into a famous book author who has hated him since grade school.

programme.title: The Millers: Reunited and It Feels So Bad
programme.desc: Tom and Carol decide to formally end their marriage but are surprised when they both hesitate to finalize the divorce, sending Nathan and Debbie into a panic at the thought of their parents reconciling.
programme.sub-title: Reunited and It Feels So Bad

programme.title: The Millers: Give Metta World Peace a Chance
programme.desc: Nathan lands the biggest interview of his career with professional basketball player Metta World Peace, but when karma catches up with him, he risks ruining his professional reputation.
programme.sub-title: Give Metta World Peace a Chance

programme.title: The Millers: Diggin' Up Bones
programme.desc: In an attempt to get Carol to be more daring, Kip encourages her to confront her old Central Elementary School work nemesis, Miss Pam (Molly Shannon), at the teacher's retirement party.

programme.title: The Millers: You Are the Wind Beneath My Wings, Man
programme.desc: When Ray points out that Nathan has a history of being the worst wingman ever, Nathan embarks on a mission to be a better friend by becoming less self-involved.
programme.sub-title: You Are the Wind Beneath My Wings, Man

programme.title: The Millers: When The Pope Comes Marching In
programme.desc: When the Pope is scheduled to come to town, Nathan's planned week-long series of reports hits a snag when Ray gets a job offer to become the cameraman for a rival field reporter.
programme.sub-title: When The Pope Comes Marching In

programme.title: The Millers: Papa Was a Rolling Bone
programme.desc: The Millers decide to spend Thanksgiving apart for the first time ever, but they rethink the new family tradition when all their individual Turkey Day plans hit unexpected snags.

programme.title: The Millers: Louise Louise
programme.desc: When The Millers get a visit from their elderly Aunt Louise (Cloris Leachman), they rally to help her figure out what her legacy will be when she worries that she hasn't left her mark on the world yet.

programme.title: The Millers: Highway to the Manger Zone
programme.desc: When staging their church's annual living nativity scene does not go as planned, Kip urges the Millers to stage their own rival show.

programme.title: The Millers: Hero
programme.desc: When Nathan decides he should have a better relationship with his niece Mikayla, he agrees to use his celebrity status to help Debbie and Adam get her into a popular school.

programme.title: The Millers: Pilot
programme.desc: Nathan and his sister, Debbie, are upset when their parents announce they're divorcing after 43 years of marriage.

programme.title: The Millers: Stuff
programme.desc: Nathan hatches a plan to get his parents back together by showing them all of their sentimental family possessions in the hopes it will make them remember the good times they've had.

programme.title: The Millers: The Phone Upgrade

programme.title: Magnus Midtbø: Climbing Solo with Alex Honnold

programme.desc: Wil Riker's renegade duplicate steals the Defiant and attacks Cardassian territory, forcing Sisko to assist Gul Dukat in stopping him.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Life Support
programme.desc: Bashir must use questionable methods in order to keep Vedek Bareil alive long enough to help bring about a Bajoran peace treaty with Cardassia.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Ties Of Blood And Water
programme.desc: The imminent death of Kira's Cardassian "father" rekindles painful memories of losing her real father

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Rocks And Shoals
programme.desc: Sisko and his crew are stranded on a remote planet with a dying Vorta and a small group of Jem'Hadar.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: En kille ska checka ut men, planer smids bakom stängda dörrar och allt kan hända på Paradise Hotel.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Dags för en sjukt het vecka där gästerna har förvandlats till sjuksköterskor och brandmän. En ny patient checkar in för att få sitt brända hjärta omhändertaget och en gäst börjar tvivla på sin pakt.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Gårdagens fest har satt sina spår, både i form av bakfylla och tvivel. Det hettar till ordentligt när hotellets brandmän bjuder på show.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Gästerna håller inte igen under Pandoras Ask och den dåliga stämningen hänger kvar länge. Trögpakten bildas, något som inte faller i god jord hos de andra gästerna nu när parceremoni står för dörren.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Det mytomspunna hotellet på Mexikos dramatiska västkust slår återigen upp portarna och det är ett taggat gäng som checkar in. Men, allt kan hända på Paradise Hotel och särskilt i händerna på JLC.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: JLC fortsätter styra premiärveckan med järnhand och redan andra dagen kommer tiden på hotellet vara över för några av gästerna. Starka känslor har etablerats mellan flera av deltagarna.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Känslorna fortsätter svalla på hotellet och spelet är i full gång. En tjej tvingas checka ut och planer smids inför den kommande parceremonin.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Säsongens första parceremoni går till historien och efterspelet är inte nådigt. Allianser börja sakta men säkert luckras upp och hur pakterna kommer se ut framöver är högst oklart.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Ny vecka i Paradiset och frågan är om hotellet är en himmel eller ett helvete? Hemligheter avslöjas och två nya gäster checkar in för att röra om ordentligt i grytan.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: En av de nya gästerna visar sig ha ett förflutet med en av killarna, till hans partners stora förtret. Ett svek uppdagas som vänder upp och ner på hela hotellet.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Skärselden fortsätter att locka fler offer och ett oväntat erbjudande dyker upp. Hur långt är man beredd att gå för att ta sig vidare? Dessutom har det blivit dags för säsongens första Pandoras Ask.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Det uppdagas att flera på hotellet har blivit erbjudna samma sak, utan varandras vetskap, och stämningen blir minst sagt kylig. Parceremonin närmar sig, men innan dess ska en av tjejerna checka ut.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Parceremonin tvingar ytterligare en tjej att checka ut och frågan är, kan lojalitet leda till attraktion? Åtminstone verkar det fungera så på Paradise Hotel.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Skolveckan är i full gång och det vankas prov i ordkunskap. Kärlek blomstrar mellan ett par av eleverna och Frökens Favorit checkar in.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: En av eleverna tvingas checka ut när Frökens Favorit tar hans partner, och fler elever börjar känna kärleken spira. Skolans Värsting gör entré och det är ingen duvunge som kommer.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Vem målade Mona-Lisa? Och är Kuwait ett land eller en frukt? Nya prövningar väntar eleverna när en immunitet står på spel. Dessutom rör en dagsfest upp starka känslor – precis innan parceremonin.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: En lojal partner är A och O på Paradise Hotel men, en back up är minst lika viktigt. Ytterligare en kille tvingas lämna hotellet och den efterföljande festen får svartsjuka att blossa upp.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Cirkusen har anlänt till Paradiset men, faror lurar i manegen. En galen mördarclown är lös på hotellet och när som helst kan någon bli mördad och tvingas checka ut.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Festen får svartsjukan att frodas och teorierna om vem som är hotellets mördarclown går isär. Två spådamer checkar in för att hjälpa till att lösa mysteriet men, vad är egentligen den röda tråden?

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Pandoras Ask kommer aldrig lägligt men kanske extra olägligt just ikväll. En allians ”behind the scenes” blir allt starkare, men kommer spådamerna att lyssna på den alliansen eller inte?

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Det är aldrig kul när en annan tjej vill ha ens kille och speciellt inte på Paradise Hotel. Hemliga allianser riskerar att avslöjas när parceremonin tvingar alla att visa sina rätta färger.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Är det ostvecka på hotellet? Dags för lederhosen och dirndl när gästerna hamnat i Alperna. Ett välbekant ansikte checkar in, redo att ge allt och bara tänka på sig själv.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: En av killarna lägger näsan i… smink, och frågan är hur det kommer påverka spelet för hans del framöver. Ytterligare ett känt ansikte gör entré, redo att hämnas på sina motståndare.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's cousin, Melancholia, wants to marry Clarence P. Harvey after most of her marital prospects have joined the Foreign Legion. Clarence recoils when Melancholia puts on a campaign to win him, backed by Morticia, Gomez and Clarence's boss.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes a veritable gazelle when he takes dancing lessons at Gomez and Morticia's suggestion after he admits to being a wallflower at social functions. Each member of the Addams Family teaches Lurch a different step.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract. The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Rockland Cartright III is a beatnik who crashes his motorbike into a tree and recuperates at the Addams house. Each regards the other as an oddity, although the family learns to appreciate certain aspects of Rockland's life.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets A Beatnik

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Mr. Briggs, the postman, is hired by the government to do undercover work in the Addams house. While pretending to be a stamp collector, he investigates rumors that coded radio messages are being sent from the house.
programme.sub-title: Addams Family Meets The Undercover Man

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.
programme.sub-title: Mother Lurch Visits The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she and Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion-dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt Visits The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones) and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up). Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family And The Spaceman

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt And The Vocational Counselor

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it he will lose her.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Paren försöker hålla sig lugna när de ser sina partners bjuda singlar på dejter, men känslorna och svartsjukan är påtaglig.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Singlar gör sitt bästa för att fånga parens uppmärksamhet. Vid den första Lägerelden är paren på helspänn. Ett par lär sig hur svårt det är att motstå frestelse.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: En överraskande eliminering skakar om husen. Paren dyker djupare in i experimentet. Vissa partners inser att de kommer allt längre från varandra.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: En ny överraskning skakar om båda villorna. Great och Nafeesah fördjupar sin relation, medan Hall drar en slutsats som förändrar allt. Marisela hittar tillbaka till sig själv när skulden börjar hinna ikapp Paris.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Temptation Light är en ständig påminnelse att det inte finns några hemligheter på ön och att alla aktioner har konsekvenser.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Det är dags för videomeddelanden, och Mark avslöjar ännu en twist. Även singlarna får nu skicka videomeddelanden.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Paren hanterar efterspelet efter videomeddelandena. Nya relationer växer sig starkare och blir intimare. Andra deltagare kämpar med skuldkänslor och osäkerheten på hur allt ska sluta.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Paren beger sig på övernattningsdejter med deras favoritsinglar. Nya romanser blossar upp, kärleksförklaringar och framtidsplaner görs upp. En till person ger efter för frestelsen.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Paren Marisela & Christopher och Vanessa & Robert återförenas för deras sista Lägereld. Var deras relationer tillräckligt starka för att överleva Temptation Island?

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Kaitlin & Hall och Paris & Great återförenas för sin sista Lägereld. Lägereldarna är bra på att reda ut saker och avslöja sanningar, även när sanningen har varit en lögn.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Paren och singlarna har återförenas under 90-minuter för att se tillbaka på sin tid på ön.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: En timme av material som aldrig tidigare visats.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Fyra par beger sig till Temptation Island för att se om de är menade för varandra.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Singlarna flyttar in och det börjar gå vilt till. Vid den första Lägerelden uppstår smärtsamma uppvaknanden.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Några par börjar njuta av sin nyfunna självständighet, medan andra är fast i det förflutna.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Spänningarna ökar i villorna. Linjerna suddas ut vid kvällens temafest.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Mark levererar en oväntad twist vid utslagningen, vilket skakar om båda villorna.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Känslorna är stora efter den mest dramatiska Lägerelden så här långt. Överraskningsgäster anländer för att röra upp än mer.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Paren skickar videomeddelanden till sina partners medan deras band till singlarna blir allt starkare.

programme.title: Andromeda: Udyrets mave
programme.desc: Et mytologisk rumuhyre forsøger at æde Andromeda.

programme.title: Andromeda: Ridderen, døden og djævelen
programme.desc: Dylan forsøger at befri en flåde af tilfangetagne skibe, men flåden er ikke sikker på, at den ønsker at blive befriet. Deres AI'er frygter, at nye kaptajner vil gøre dem til slaver.

programme.title: Andromeda: Ubesmittet opfattelse
programme.desc: Genitter angriber Tyrs kone og koloni.

programme.title: Andromeda: Tunnelen for enden af lyset
programme.desc: Med halvtreds parter om bord er Dylan vært for underskrivelsen af det nye rigsfællesskabs charter, men opdager snart, at der er ubudne gæster, der har til hensigt at stoppe underskrivelsen.

programme.title: Andromeda: Hvis hjulet er fastgjort
programme.desc: Beka og Tyr bliver overtaget af energien fra en dimensionstunnel. Dylan, Trance og Harper må redde dem, før de ødelægger skibet.

programme.title: Andromeda: Rimnis skår
programme.desc: Dylan bliver anklaget for mord og skal rense sit navn, mens han finder delene af en vase, der siges at give ejeren "kosmos velsignelser

programme.title: Andromeda: Gal for at blive reddet
programme.desc: Besætningen redder en gruppe flygtninge, men opdager, at de har været udsat for regeringens eksperimenter og er ekstremt ustabile.

programme.title: Andromeda: Cui Bono
programme.desc: Beka's onkel stiller op til et embede i det nye Commonwealth, men et mordforsøg får besætningen til at agere som hans sikkerhed.

programme.title: Andromeda: Det ensomme og jævne sand
programme.desc: Da Andromeda bliver angrebet af pirater i rummet, bliver de reddet af et længe forsvundet rumskib fra Jorden.

programme.title: Andromeda: Krigshundene Slipfighter
programme.desc: Besætningen opdager, at en slyngelplanet, Marduk, har fremstillet masseødelæggelsesvåben.

programme.title: Andromeda: Den spedalskes kys
programme.desc: En lejemorder ved navn Leper er ude efter lederne af det nye Commonwealth.

programme.title: Andromeda: For Whom the Bell Tolls
programme.desc: Andromeda bliver hjemsøgt af et mystisk væsen, der kommer om bord under en solstorm.

programme.title: Andromeda: And Your Heart Will Fly Away
programme.desc: Da en længe savnet kærlighed vender tilbage, forsvinder Tyr fra skibet for at beskytte hende mod en lejemorder.
programme.sub-title: And Your Heart Will Fly Away

programme.title: Andromeda: Den uovervindelige mand
programme.desc: Spiller i et alternativt univers, hvor Dylan er død, og Gaheris Rhade forsøger at reformere Commonwealth.

programme.title: Andromeda: Delenda Est
programme.desc: Den gruppe, der angreb Andromeda under den første underskrivelse af Commonwealth-charter, vender tilbage for at skabe mere ravage.

programme.title: Andromeda: Det mørke bagud
programme.desc: Trance gennemgår nogle forskellige scenarier og forsøger at finde et, hvor hendes besætningsmedlemmer ikke dør.

programme.title: Andromeda: Risiko-alt-punktet
programme.desc: Et kraftigere Andromeda skib eksploderer sandsynligvis på grund af sabotage, hvilket tvinger Dylans besætning til at redde dem.

programme.title: Andromeda: Den rigtige hest
programme.desc: Beka bringer både sin besætning og en hel planet i fare, da en tidligere kærlighed dukker op.

programme.title: Andromeda: Hvad sker der med en udskudt rev?
programme.desc: Andromeda modtager et råb om hjælp fra Rev Bam.
programme.sub-title: Hvad sker der med en udskudt rev?

programme.title: Andromeda: Spidsen af spyddet
programme.desc: Efter at en planet i Commonwealth bliver angrebet af pyroformere fra Pyrian, er Dylan tvunget til at kæmpe for at beskytte den nye planet.

programme.title: Andromeda: Himlens hvælving
programme.desc: Dylan hører stemmer, der lokker ham til en planet med "ild og is".

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Big Chill
programme.desc: For years, a woman suffered from what appeared to be the unpleasant side effects of lithium, a drug prescribed to treat bipolar disorder. When she died, investigators had to determine if her death was due to natural causes, suicide or murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hunter or Hunted
programme.desc: A woman is killed while walking her dogs in the woods. Since she has no enemies and her husband has an alibi, police assume it's a hunting accident — until they find a strange letter, allegedly written by the woman before her death.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Ghost in the Machine
programme.desc: While investigating the apparent overdose suicide of Reverend Bill Guthrie's wife, detectives recover incriminating files from Bill's computer and learn of his infidelity.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Alibi
programme.desc: In 1991, a high school girl vanished after attending a party. The prime suspect had two alibi witnesses for the night she disappeared. A solid alibi can often overcome circumstantial evidence, but forensic evidence is another matter.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Touching Recollection
programme.desc: The investigation into the kidnapping and rape of an 18-year-old Ohio woman is aided when the victim returns hours after the incident occurred. With her help, the police are able to track the assailant to his front door.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Smiley Face
programme.desc: The woman had been sexually assaulted, stabbed repeatedly and left for dead. When a perfect suspect practically turned himself in, police were sure they had their man until DNA evidence proved them wrong.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Time Will Tell
programme.desc: In this international case of extortion, murder and stolen identities, scam-artist Albert J. Walker assumes the identity of co-worker Ronald Platt. Platt later turns up dead in an ocean with an anchor tied around his torso.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Bagging a Killer
programme.desc: In 1999, 9-year-old Valiree Jackson vanished on her way to school near Spokane. Her father, Brad Jackson, reported the disappearance and the entire community started searching for her abductor.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Duelling Confessions
programme.desc: When Rosemary Anderson is found dead on the side of the road, her boyfriend becomes the prime suspect. He eventually confessed to her murder, but so did another man: serial killer Eric Edgar Cooke.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Chief Suspect
programme.desc: The wife of a respected police officer was murdered in her own home. The crime went unsolved for more than a decade, until a newly formed cold case unit took a fresh look at the evidence.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Unholy Alliance
programme.desc: When a young woman disappeared, police feared she was the latest victim in a string of similar crimes. A pair of bloody gloves, unique tire tracks and ordinary pine needles provided investigators with some extraordinary clues.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dessert Served Cold
programme.desc: A man dies in his home after a long history of heart disease. A few weeks after the funeral, rumors surface that the death was no accident.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Church Disappearance
programme.desc: In 1981, 6-year-old Cassie Hansen disappeared from her Minnesota church during an evening service. After receiving a tip that an older man was seen carrying a small person, police found Cassie's body in a dumpster.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Skin of Her Teeth
programme.desc: In 1994, a human skull retrieved from an Ohio pond reveals a ghastly crime. Markings on the skull indicate that the victim had been stabbed multiple times and that the teeth had been removed with needle-nose pliers.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Screen Pass
programme.desc: A 13-year-old girl went missing from her Colorado home. The only evidence the kidnapper left behind was three fingerprints on a window screen.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Grounds for Indictment
programme.desc: A drive-by shooting leaves one man dead and another seriously wounded. Cell phone calls and shell casings point to a suspect, but authorities are unable to place him at the crime scene. A forensic geologist proves that dirt is anything but dumb.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sip of Sins
programme.desc: In the 1980s, a trio of unsolved murders occurred in Wichita Falls, Texas. Later, a fourth murder from the same time period provided the police with far more than they realized.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Partners in Crime
programme.desc: In a 1992 murder case, the autopsy of a cremated body turns up telltale clues of foul play.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Insignificant Others
programme.desc: How unlucky could one man be? His college sweetheart killed herself and fourteen years later, his wife ended her life in a similar way. Investigators had to determine if this was murder or simply a bizarre coincidence.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Fishing for the Truth
programme.desc: A two-man shrimp boat sinks when a fast-moving, violent storm strikes the Louisiana coast. The captain drowns, but the deckhand is rescued fourteen hours later. The crewman is hailed as a hero — until the captain's body is discovered.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Music Case

programme.title: Forensic Files: If I Were You

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sphere of Influence
programme.desc: When an 11-year-old girl disappears from a remote Alaska town, investigators wonder if she has been attacked by a bear or become lost in the dense woods. Eventually, they realize that neither assumption is true.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Past Lives
programme.desc: The body of a wealthy American businessman was found in his rental car. Teeth and bone fragments were the only remains. When the victim's wife files an insurance claim for $7 million, investigators seek the help of a renowned forensic anthropologist.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Double Trouble
programme.desc: In 1995, when off-duty Maine State Trooper Vicky Gardner is attacked by Steven Fortin during a routine stop, it triggers a chain of events which jumpstart a stalled murder case in New Jersey.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Nursery Crimes

programme.title: Forensic Files: Breaking News

programme.title: Forensic Files: Fired-Up

programme.title: Forensic Files: Touch of Evil

programme.title: Forensic Files: Separation Anxiety

programme.title: Forensic Files: Over a Barrel

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Caught in the act, a disguised bank robber hurled explosives at police and disappeared in a hail of bullets. When police identified the suspect, they connected him to an armed kidnapping, but they couldn't find him.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Human Prey
programme.desc: Thomas Dillon killed five outdoorsmen at random over a period of three years in rural southern Ohio. After a tip led the FBI to the murder weapon, ballistic testing made a match.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the southwest one serial bank robber claimed his loot went to the poor, but this thief was no folk hero. He had a gun and was willing to shoot.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killing Spree
programme.desc: In 1984, in South Florida, a rapist and murderer was on the loose. The killer was a ruthless and terrifying predator, the newest member of an infamous group known as serial killers.

programme.desc: The sun set on the Wild West long ago, but some people refused to notice. Claude Dallas was one of them. A wily trapper, Dallas typified the rugged individualism that forged this country. He went too far when he killed two game wardens in 1981.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Cat and Mouse
programme.desc: He was a predator, abducting girls and young women from their own front yards in broad daylight. He was a sadist: phoning one victim's family, taunting them, boosting then dashing their hope, and he wouldn't stop until we stopped him.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Above the Law
programme.desc: California Highway Patrolman George Gwaltney discovered the body of 23-year-old Robin Bishop near her car on a remote desert highway.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Shattered Shield
programme.desc: In a city awash in narcotics the drug lords have all the power even over the police. Corruption in New Orleans grew like cancer, eating away at public safety and threatening to destroy the city. Crooked cops break the laws they were sworn to uphold.

programme.title: The FBI Files: A Model Killer
programme.desc: It's a model's job to rivet the public's attention. But in 1984, some aspiring models began attracting publicity in a terrible new way.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Dead Run
programme.desc: In Pennsylvania, an inmate escaped with the help of his female accomplice. Following a trail of fraudulent credit card receipts and deaths, authorities track the pair, but always find themselves one step behind.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: A kidnapping can shatter a family, bringing terror and heartache without warning. In 1984 with the flash of a gun, an ordinary business transaction became a violent abduction. In seconds, the son of a wealthy Miami developer was gone.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the 1990s, neighborhoods in Detroit were terrorized by a gang of robbers. Impersonating police officers, they invaded over 100 homes robbing, raping and torturing their victims.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Small Town Terror
programme.desc: In a small Ohio community, an elderly woman and a teenaged boy disappeared. Because they vanished within hours of each other, police believed the cases were linked. But they didn't know how.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the late 70s and early 80s, a legitimate Puerto Rican independence movement took hold in the United States. But a splinter terrorist group known as the FALN was suspected of executing hundreds of bombings in major US cities.

programme.title: The FBI Files: A Family Torn
programme.desc: The parents of 11 yr. old Brittany Martinez knew their daughter was no runaway. Something had happened to her, something terrible. When they failed to find Brittany in their quiet Illinois neighborhood, they called the police.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Living In Terror
programme.desc: Terrorism: Thanks to new technology and, perhaps, the approaching millennium, terrorism is a growing international threat. The Oklahoma City explosion and the bombing of the World Trade Center are just two of the incidents of this growing problem.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Lethal Obsessions
programme.desc: Some people will let nothing stand between them and their goals. In their tortured minds, raw desire replaces all reason, and homicide becomes a convenient means to an end.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Traces Of Guilt
programme.desc: Sometimes the scales of justice are balanced by just a few milligrams of evidence: a couple of fibers, a tooth filling, or a smudge on a piece of tape. The biggest cases are often solved by the smallest clues.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Electronic Witness
programme.desc: George Orwell's concept of Big Brother remains in the realm of fiction. But as technology becomes more a part of our lives, it's becoming increasingly more difficult to make a move without leaving behind an electronic trace.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Dead Wrong
programme.desc: Hiding a body can be difficult; it's sometimes easier to obscure or disguise the circumstances of the death, turning murder into suicide, or pinning the blame on someone else. The truth is told through subtle clues taken from the crime scene.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Lasting Impressions
programme.desc: No matter how chaotic or how clean a crime scene appears to be, the culprit is bound to leave something telling behind. Occasionally, it's nothing more than a fingerprint or shoe tread. Sometimes that's all that's needed.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Women Who Kill
programme.desc: Men don't have a monopoly on murder, but it's still extraordinary when women kill. Though female killers are as deadly as males, they choose less violent methods.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Deadly Dealings
programme.desc: For a price, anything's possible. Contract killings arose out of the need to establish the perfect alibi. By hiring someone else to do the dirty work, a person can deflect guilt, at least in theory.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Body Count
programme.desc: Some people do get away with murder, at least for a while. Flush with their success, serial killers murder again and again. But each time they kill, they leave behind a few more clues, which ultimately lead to their undoing.

programme.title: The New Detectives: A Taste of Poison
programme.desc: Poisoners are the most devious of killers, relying on stealth or their victim's trust in order to steal their lives. They're the most dangerous creatures in the world: smart assassins. And they usually don't stop at one kill.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Grave Discoveries
programme.desc: Some cases simply can't be solved with current technology or with the evidence at hand. But that doesn't mean they'll remain unsolved forever.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Texas Rangers
programme.desc: Formed in the 1830s to protect settlers against Indian attack, the Rangers became part of the Texas Highway Patrol in 1935. Their role has continued to evolve to keep up with changing times; today it includes sophisticated forensics labs.

programme.desc: Drug trafficking has spawned a violent and deadly criminal underground. It's providing a challenge to forensic investigators devoted to cracking drug rings.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Unlikely Sources
programme.desc: Some of the best clues come from the least likely places. Baffling crimes have been solved and criminals betrayed through evidence provided by insects, beer bottles, and other seemingly meaningless objects.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Vesta Unveiled
programme.desc: With the Dawn missions exploration of the asteroid Vesta and the dwarf planet Ceres, asteroids are a hot topic. See what these incredible missions have uncovered.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Science and the Shuttle
programme.desc: For more than 25 years the shuttle was our ticket to space, and our laboratory in orbit. Uncover the legacy of this amazing machine, and see what lies ahead.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: The Hot Zone
programme.desc: Mercury is one Earth's closest neighbors, but for centuries it eluded astronomer's best efforts to learn its secrets. But that has changed thanks to missions like Mariner and most recently, Messenger.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: The Space Shuttle Matures, Complex Space Construction & The Final Years of the Space Shuttle

programme.sub-title: The Space Shuttle Matures, Complex Space Construction & The Final Years of the Space Shuttle

programme.title: The Mystery of Dark Matter
programme.desc: Dark matter, which is unknown and undetectable in our physical models, would appear to populate the cosmos on a massive scale. For the first time, a film portrays the wild scientific quest that dark matter gives rise to - a real thriller!

programme.desc: The world famous Apollo missions are some of the greatest feats ever accomplished by man. With rare archive footage and unprecedented access to life on board the Apollo spacecrafts, this stunning one-hour special brings scientific history to life.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Mars: Adapt or Leave
programme.desc: Air, water, food, electricity and fuel all the essentials to explore the solar system, this episode explores the innovative plans for astronauts to grow their own food and extract water and fuel at their destinations.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Inner Worlds
programme.desc: They orbit between our planet and our star. Mercury and Venus make up half of our terrestrial planets, but we still know very little about them. As we take a closer look at our companions, we find more questions than answers.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Astronauts
programme.desc: Who are these people that venture into space? Once they were test pilots, then scientists and engineers now teachers, politicians and paying tourists what does it take to earn the astronaut wings?

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Edge of the Universe
programme.desc: The night sky is a time machine. The further we look out into the universe, the further back in time we reach. Most of what we see is actually dark matter and dark energy, but its nature eludes us... for the moment.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Rocky Shores / Silent Partner
programme.desc: See the sun, moon, planets, and galaxies through the eyes of intrepid machines that are blazing a trail across the solar system. A gateway to bold adventures, these cameras are delivering spectacular new cosmic vistas.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Cosmic Rainbow
programme.desc: In the world of astronomy, how do we overcome the limits imposed by our own eyesight? The universe comes alive by viewing the cosmos in infrared light to gamma radiation.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Stargazer's Paradise
programme.desc: The Atacama desert is a perfect place for watching the night sky. With still winds and only a handful of cloudy nights each year, it allows scientists to get the absolute most out of their tools.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Next Stop Mars

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Interface

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Landing on Mars
programme.desc: Mars sparks our curiosity like no other planet because it is so reachable. Despite having landed there, most of the information we gather is still done by instruments in the planet's orbit.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: The Big Bang

programme.title: Inside Outer Space: Episode 1: The Solar System
programme.desc: This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see, how we can live in space and what science tells us about the past and the future as we journey inside out of space.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space: Episode 7: The Milky Way

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Orbit

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Sling Shot

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Fermi Paradox
programme.desc: The Fermi Paradox asks the ultimate question: Given a few reasonable assumptions about the chance of life arising elsewhere in the universe and the distance between the stars, why has an alien civilization not presented itself?

programme.title: Inside Outer Space: Episode 2: Moons
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space: Episode 5: Space Missions
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see.

programme.title: One Small Step: Neil Armstrong

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: Project Gemini Docking, Mars Curiousity & Satellite Swarms

programme.desc: Interviews with Apollo 8 astronauts, their wives, mission control staff, and journalists give true insider's perspective to the space race of the late 1960's.

programme.sub-title: You Always Miss a Best Friend

programme.title: The Hills: I Heidi Take Thee Spencer

programme.sub-title: I Always Had A Little Crush

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: A Sea Of Tears
programme.desc: Det syder i villaen, når ikke bare en, men tre ekser ankommer og skaber kaos for turtelduerne Ross og Harriette. Zahidas eks Joe mister kontrollen, og Alex truer med at drukne sig i tårer.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Harriette's Love Triangle
programme.desc: Singlernes elendighed fortsætter, da Sean springer fra Zahida til Zaralena, og Harriettes kærlighedstrekant bliver værre. Maisie vil have, der skal ske noget, og Aaron fra 'Geordie Shore' gør en storslået entré, men hvem af ekserne er hans?

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Nicole's Nightmare
programme.desc: Spændingerne i villaen når kogepunktet, da Zaralena får Zahidas vrede at føle. Den nye eks får fyrene til at føre sig territorialt. Josh har et godt øje til Nicole, men slutter det, da hun opdager en knusende hemmelighed?

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: The Blonde Bombshell
programme.desc: Adam afslører sine følelser for Nicole, og Jack og Josh vil have nyt blod i villaen. Zaralena og Aaron kommer tættere på hinanden, og Ross og Harriette tilbringer natten i loftslejligheden. Men en ny eks kan ødelægge det for alle.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Harriette's Heartache
programme.desc: Terrortabletten gør livet surt for Becca. Harriettes hjertesorg bliver værre, og Zaralenas elendighed fortsætter, men det er den nyeste eks, der truer med at skabe det værste kaos.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: The Truth Comes Out
programme.desc: Ankomsten af endnu en eks fører til et blodbad i villaen. Nicole må høre sandheden om Jacques Fraser, mens Ross og Harriette skændes igen. Og Zaralena tager en stor beslutning.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Jacques Comeuppance
programme.desc: Jacques Fraser får omsider sin straf. Det nyeste ekser stormer stranden og villaen, skaber splid mellem Sean og Zahida og skaber kaos for resten.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Aaron Moves On
programme.desc: Der kommer to nye ekser, til Aarons glæde og Beccas fortvivlelse. Maisie når bunden, Harriette får et sammenbrud og Sean og Jack kommer ryger i totterne på hinanden.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Big Fat Greek Wedding
programme.desc: Terrortabletten holder et stort græsk bryllup for Sean og Zahida, men da den sidste eks kommer, bliver festen kaotisk. Harriette får en chokerende besked af Ross.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Karma's a Bitch
programme.desc: I udfordringen afslører fyrenes ekser ting og sager og overnatter i huset. Brittany har svært ved at acceptere, at Adam ikke er interesseret. Og Coleysia og Ashleigh tænder op under romantikken.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Double Shot
programme.desc: Situationen er spændt mellem John og Simone. Kayla bliver interesseret i Wes igen, men hun holder stasig fast i Ryan. Humøret stiger, da de kan sende to par i sandhedsboksen efter udfordringen.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Turn The Paige
programme.desc: Alle præver at regne ud, hvem der er det perfekte par. Kayla bliver afsløret, da hun spiller Ryan ud mod Wes, og Simone prøver at splitte Chris T og Shanley. Et besøg i sandhedsboksen vender op og ned på alt i huset.

programme.title: Are You The One?: It's So Hard...To Say Goodbye
programme.desc: Huset er rystet, da Paige og Chris T bliver bekræftet som det perfekte par og sendes til Bryllupssuiten. Shanley er totalt knust efter at være blevet skilt fra Chris T, og Kayla flipper ud, da Ryan vil trøste Jessica.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Getting Dumped On
programme.desc: Kayla og Ryan skændes, men huset vender sig mod Kayla, da hun afslører følsomme oplysninger, der truer Ambers forhold til Ethan. En slibrig udfordring tester nogle af parrenes evne til at holde sammen.

programme.title: Are You The One?: White Party
programme.desc: Til hvid fest har alle i huset det sjovt, men John må forholde sig til Jacys følelser for Scali. I en udfordring på stranden får parrene sand under neglene.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Rub Down With A Happy Ending
programme.desc: Huset forsøger at regne ud, hvordan de finder deres perfekte match og vinder en million dollars. Jacy ser sine følelser for Scali og John i øjnene, da huset forsøger at løse den sidste kærlighedstrekant.
programme.sub-title: Rub Down With A Happy Ending

programme.title: Are You The One?: Reunion Special
programme.desc: Alle de tyve deltagere bliver genforenet med Ryan Devlin for at diskutere, hvad der skete på Hawaii, og vi viser ikke tidligere vist materiale, chokerende afsløringer og sladder om parrene som fortsat er sammen.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Are You The One? Special Delivery
programme.desc: Deltagerne i første sæson genforenes til den største begivenhed i Ethans og Ambers liv - en baby! Find ud af, hvordan det er gået med deltagerne, mens de tilbringer en vild weekend sammen for at fejre babyen med et AYTO-gave.
programme.sub-title: Are You The One? Special Delivery

programme.title: Are You The One?: One Too Many
programme.desc: 10 perfekt sammensatte fyre og piger får et chok, når de finder ud af, det bliver sværere at finde 10 par, for der er 11 piger. Paris og Pratt prøver at undgå den første sandhedsbås.

programme.title: Are You The One?: The Truth Will Cost You
programme.desc: Teamet bliver spændt, da både Layton og Shelby havner i kærlighedstrekanter. Fyrene graver ting op om pigerne i en konkurrence, som kan sende den ellevte pige i sandhedsbåsen.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Virgin Tears
programme.desc: Der er tårer, da Shelby afslutter sin kærlighedstrekant. John prøver at nærme sig Christina, men bliver blokeret af Brandon, hendes ikke-match. Teamet bliver chokeret da de hører, at der er en jomfru blandt dem.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Loose Lips Sink Relationships
programme.desc: En fuld kikser kan splitte det stærkeste par i huset. Anthony bager heftigt på Laytons forelskelse, Jenni. John prøver endelig lykken med Christina. Parceremonien gør huset helt rundt på gulvet.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Strap Those Boots Tight
programme.desc: Huset er chokeret efter sidste parceremoni. Jenni mener, at Layton er hendes rette fyr, men frygter at en knust Jessica bliver vred. For et par truer sandhedsbåsen med at bringe mere hjertesorg.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Parental Guidance
programme.desc: Pigerne får overraskende informationer, når deres forældre kommer for at udspørge fyrene. Når forældrene rejser, eksploderer spændingerne mellem Layton og Anthony. Huset finder ud af, at historien kan gentage sig.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Hot Salsa
programme.desc: Efter en mislykket parceremoni er huset klar til en ny start. John mener endelig at have fundet den rette i Jenni, men de andre i huset er ikke så sikre. Ashley befinder sig i et potentielt eksplosivt trekantsdrama.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Dumped
programme.desc: Kampen mellem Dario og Layton over Ashley strammer til. Ellie vender sin opmærksomhed mod Nathan, som er overbevist om, at Christina er hans perfekte partner. For Christina bliver presset med at være pige nummer 11 for meget.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Old Flames
programme.desc: Selvom de ikke er et par, eksploderer Nathan, når Christina går tilbage til Brandon. Med to parceremonier tilbage, kunne Ashleys ubeslutsomhed mellem Layton og Dario afholde huset fra at vinde det hele.

programme.title: Are You The One?: One Switch, One Glitch
programme.desc: Det er den sidste parceremoni og de skal udskifte et par. Mens sandhedsbåsen giver et tiltrængt svar, bringer spørgsmålet om pige nummer 11 millionen i fare.

programme.title: Are You The One?: The Season Aftermatch
programme.desc: Hele sæsonens hemmeligheder, drama og uafklarede affærer kommer frem i lyset i dette genforeningsafsnit, hvor de medvirkende skiftes til at sidde i den varme stol.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Perfect Match at First Sight
programme.desc: 20 singler ankommer til Hawaii for at finde kærlighed og vinde 1 million dollar. Deres kærlighed ved første blik-instinkter bliver sat på prøve med 250.000 ekstra på spil. En kærlighedstrekant fører til en pinlig parceremoni.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Punch Drunk Love
programme.desc: John eksploderer, når forholdet til Julia forandrer sig. Asaf og Francesca ved ikke, hvor de står, da en tur til bolleværelset kikser. Kaylen slipper en bombe om sit forhold til Gio, som chokerer huset.
